{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for QA orders
assert len(df_completed[df_completed['revenue'] == '999999.99']) == 0, "QA orders found in completed dataset."

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast to float
df_completed['revenue_numeric'] = df_completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = df_completed['revenue_numeric'].mean()

# Print result
mean_revenue"}
